note: White is mating but plays Qd5?? dropping the queen on the open d-file. A rich coach should name the open file + the thrown-away mate and point to Rh8+.
coachText: Qd5 drops the queen — the rook on d8 sits on the same open file and just takes it, and you also gave up the mate you already had. Play Rh8+ instead; it's a forcing check that leads straight to mate. When you're completely winning, look for forcing checks before anything else.
